sections_target.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Set the Change-over Switch (43), type BH-H7, for breaker failure protection testing to the Test position on the protection cubicle
Short the points (a17,18), (a11,12), (a11,12), (a11,12) on the Test plug type HP2-C8
Insert the test plug type HP2-C8 in the Test socket type HR2A-C8 of the relay (z50BF) on the protection cubicle
Inject current at points (a21,22) in the Test plug to test phase R until the signal appears
Record the current (Operating) value for phase R
Reduce the current gradually until the signal disappears
Record the current (Operating) value for phase R
Inject current at points (a25,26) in the Test plug to test phase T until the signal appears
Record the current (Operating) value for phase T
Reduce the current gradually until the signal disappears
Record the current (Operating) value for phase T
Inject current at points (x27,28) in the Test plug to test the neutral point N until the signal appears
Record the current (Operating) value for the neutral point N
Reduce the current gradually until the signal disappears
Record the current Resetting value for the neutral point N
Set the Switch to the Off position
Connect the two Stop terminals of the timer to points (a13,14) on the relay (z50BF)
Connect the two Start terminals of the timer to the terminals of one side of the Switch
Connect the two terminals of the other side of the Switch to points (a1,10) on the relay (z50BF)
Inject current at points (a21,22) in the Test Plug, of value (2x Operating) for phase R
Set the Switch to the ON position
Record the Operating time value for phase R
Set the Switch to the Off position
Record the Operating time value for phase R
Inject current at points (a25,26) in the Test Plug, of value (2x Operating Value) for phase T
Set the Switch to the ON position
Record the Operating time value for phase T
Set the Switch to the Off position
Record the Operating time value for phase T
Inject current at points (a27,28) in the Test Plug, of value (2x Operating Value) for the neutral point N
Set the Switch to the ON position
Record the Operating time value for the neutral point N
Set the Switch to the Off position
Record the Operating time value for the neutral point N
Remove the Test plug type HP2-C8 from the Test socket type HR2A-C8 of the relay (50BF) on the protection cubicle
Restart the relay (50BF) on the protection cubicle
Restart the (Lock Out Relay) of the relay (50BF) on the protection cubicle
Set the Change-over Switch (43), type BH-H7, for breaker failure protection testing to the Normal position on the protection cubicle
2. Tap value test of OC element

sections_target.text: Measure the operating value of O.C element of each setting tap when C.B failure initiation contact is closed
Criteria : Operating value Less than 50% of setting
Resetting value More than 90 % of setting

rows: 3. Tap value test of time element

sections_target.text: Operating time : Measure the time after CB failure
Resetting time : Measure the time after CB failure
Criteria : Operating time setting value 10 ms

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for testing and calibrating the breaker failure protection device for disconnection, as shown above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Faisal at the Assiut Thermal Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out on 06 April 2003 by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Faisal.
Safety Precautions
Isolate the circuit breaker whose breaker failure protection is to be tested, and also isolate the breaker's two disconnectors
Open a work order
Fence off the work area
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Current injection test set, type SVERKER 650
AC V-A current measuring instrument, type YOKOGAWA
Millisecond Counter (Timer) Type MCS - 5N
Test comb, type RTXH 18
Test leads
Switch 2 pole (used in the timing measurement circuit)

uncertain_terms.note: Unclear qualifier in the equipment name ("for disconnection"); rendered as "for disconnection" and flagged.
Source repeats the point (a11,12) three times in the shorting list; kept verbatim.
Suspect source values: the second recording after reducing the current is labelled "(Operating)" in the source where "Resetting" would be expected (as in step 17); kept faithful to the source.
Source wording in step 23; read as "(2x Operating)" (twice the operating value).
Inconsistent relay designation in the source: steps 3–22 use (z50BF), steps 44–46 use (a50BF)/(50BF); kept verbatim per step.
Rendered as "test comb" (test plug comb), type RTXH 18.
Source typo in step 29 for "سجل"; translated as "Record".
